question: How do I track my order?
answer: Open the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email, or give us your order number and we will look up the latest status.

question: Where is my order?
answer: Check the tracking link in your confirmation email. If the status has not changed for 3 days, share your order number and a teammate will investigate.

question: Can I change or cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them. After that the order may already be packed, and a teammate can check if it can still be stopped.

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answer: Address changes are possible only before the order ships. Once it has shipped, a teammate must contact the carrier, so please share your order number.

question: I did not receive an order confirmation email. What should I do?
answer: Check your spam or junk folder first. If it is not there, confirm that the email address on your account is correct and ask us to resend it.

question: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
answer: We are sorry about that. Send your order number and a photo of the damage within 7 days of delivery and a teammate will arrange a replacement or refund.

question: My order is missing an item. What should I do?
answer: Check whether the item shipped in a separate package. If not, send your order number and the item name, and a teammate will resolve it.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times start after the order ships.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping costs a flat fee shown at checkout. Orders above the free shipping minimum ship free. Express shipping has an extra charge.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: International shipping is available to selected countries. Delivery time and fees are shown at checkout once you enter your address.

question: Can I choose a delivery time slot?
answer: Delivery slots are not available at present. The carrier will deliver during normal working hours and you will receive tracking updates.

question: What if I am not home when the courier arrives?
answer: The courier will usually try again on the next business day or leave a collection notice. You can also use the tracking link to rearrange delivery.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund or exchange.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Request a return from your account or send us your order number. We will email a return label with simple instructions.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item. Your bank may need extra time to show it.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
answer: Yes. Request an exchange within 30 days of delivery, and we will send the new item once the original has been received.

question: Who pays for return shipping?
answer: Return shipping is free if the item is faulty or the wrong item was sent. For other returns, a return fee may be deducted from the refund.

question: Which items cannot be returned?
answer: Gift cards, personalised items and opened hygiene products cannot be returned unless they arrive faulty.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, UPI and net banking. The available methods are shown at checkout.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Payments are processed by a secure payment provider. We do not store your full card details.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Common reasons are incorrect card details, insufficient balance or a bank security check. Try again or use another method, and contact your bank if it continues.

question: I was charged twice. What should I do?
answer: Duplicate charges are often temporary holds that disappear in a few days. If it is still there after 5 business days, share your order number so a teammate can check.

question: Can I get an invoice for my order?
answer: Yes. Invoices are available in your account under order history, and we can also email a copy on request.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address. We will send a link to set a new password.

question: How do I update my email address or phone number?
answer: Sign in, open Account settings, and edit your contact details. A confirmation may be sent to the new address.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Send us a request from your registered email address and a teammate will confirm and delete your account and personal data.

question: I cannot sign in to my account. What should I do?
answer: Check that your email is correct and try resetting your password. If it still fails, contact us so a teammate can verify your account.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: The AI agent answers at any time. Human teammates are available during business hours and will follow up on handed-over cases.

question: How do I talk to a human?
answer: Ask for a human at any time. The agent will pass the conversation, with its full history, to a teammate who will follow up.

question: How can I give feedback or make a complaint?
answer: Share your feedback in this chat or by email. A teammate will review complaints and reply.
